{{Quote|These are our newest experiments, modeled on the B-2 battle droid.|Muhrlein introduces B-2A|<ref name="AotE1" />}}
'''B-2A''' was an experimental [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] produced for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[Imperial Research Station 61]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and its partner unit [[B-2B]], were based on the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]], possessing the same basic appearance but with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and altered arm weaponry. After the two droid's creation the research station's commandant, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Milosh Muhrlein]] had them installed in the walls of his office as a security measure against intruders. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] Muhrlein found [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Jahan Cross]] [[Mission to Imperial Research Station 61|searching]] through the files in his office for evidence of [[Black market/Legends|black market]] dealings. Muhrelin attempted to bribe Cross not to reveal the evidence he found, but failed and then ordered the droids to attack. Both advanced on Cross opening fire, but the agent's [[Human replica droid]] [[IN-GA 44]] returned fire and destroyed both units.<ref name="AotE1" />

==Behind the scenes==
B-2A first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]], which was written by [[John Ostrander]] as part of the "[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse|Iron Eclipse]]" story arc of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' series.
